method: Independent actual-pixel inspection of all seven final Blender render images against A-series existing-condition survey drawings and historical report photographs; README and parameters reviewed.
scope: 2012 survey principal complete exterior shell, not present repaired condition, original construction, interior or measured reproduction.
findings: Complete rectangular main shell and gabled corrugated-metal roof match A-series geometry.
Front central three door groups, three upper large windows, three gable slits and paired angular decorative openings retained.
Both long sides show seven upper narrow windows and three lower door groups plus four horizontal window groups.
Rear uses distinct stepped low projection with two high narrow pilasters and three gable slits, not a copy of the front.
Historical photographs support approximate cream walls and reddish-purple corrugated roof; clean palette does not recreate weathering.
All six whole-model views retain complete visible building/base silhouette after top-camera correction. Entry detail is intentionally cropped and labelled.
correction_verified: Initial top preview clipped end projections/base. Final top preview has adequate margins around complete model and was re-inspected.
limits: Nominal 1:150; 30.10 m and 20.11 m refer to axis spans, not total bounding dimensions.
Survey elevation ground datums differ; flat base and nominal eave integration disclosed.
Projection depths, wall offsets, trim thickness, window placement are traced/estimated, not direct measurements.
Opaque closed relief openings; pane bars, ornament and corrugation count simplified.
Weathering, lettering, temporary objects, equipment and neighboring structures omitted; damage hatching not treated as geometric holes.
No actual print, structural, watertightness or format validation is claimed by this visual review. Separate QA reports must establish those results.
